pois.name: Walt Disney Concert Hall
pois.description: Frank Gehry's 2003 stainless steel sculpture (55m). Home of the LA Philharmonic. The acoustics, by Yasuhisa Toyota, are among the finest in the world.

pois.name: The Broad
pois.description: Diller Scofidio + Renfro's 2015 contemporary art museum with a 'veil-and-vault' structure. Jeff Koons, Cindy Sherman, Jean-Michel Basquiat. Free admission.

pois.name: Los Angeles City Hall
pois.description: The 1928 Art Deco tower (138m) that dominated the LA skyline for 35 years due to building height laws. Featured in Dragnet and Blade Runner.

pois.name: Bradbury Building
pois.description: George Wyman's 1893 iron-and-glass commercial palace. The ornate atrium — inspired by a utopian novel — has appeared in Blade Runner and 500 Days of Summer.

pois.name: Grand Central Market
pois.description: LA's oldest public market (1917), spanning an entire Broadway block. 40 vendors — from egg tostadas to Salvadoran pupusas. Open daily 8am–10pm.
